## 🐳 Docker images

Official images for this release:

```
docker pull kostad02/steam-idler-server:__VERSION__
docker pull kostad02/steam-idler-client:__VERSION__
```

The `latest` tag always points to the newest release.
The easiest way to run Steam Idler is Docker Compose, check [how to set up](https://github.com/KostaD02/steam-idler#how-to-set-up).

## 📦 What's included

**`steam-idler-__VERSION__.zip`** contains the production build output for this version:

- `apps/client` - compiled Angular client
- `apps/server` - compiled NestJS server
